purpose: The evaluation protocol GEN11 must reuse unchanged for any number that is compared against the GEN10 control.

splits.hash: BLAKE2b (inside seeded_group_kfold); Python hash() is never used
splits.verified: fold assignment recomputed for all 5 seeds and compared row-by-row against oof_finalists.parquet: 0 mismatches in 5 x 5,248 rows

metrics.macro_mae: lanthanide_separation.gen9.metrics.macro_mae, unit='ecfp_cluster'; computed per split seed and averaged over the 5 seeds
metrics.offset_mae: lanthanide_separation.gen6.metrics.decompose_level_shape -> summary['offset_mae'] = mean over ligands of |mean residual|
metrics.shape_metrics: lanthanide_separation.gen9.metrics.curve_shape_table + summarise_shape over runs/gen9_shape/curves/curve_membership.parquet; span_recovery guarded at true span >= 0.5
metrics.shape_aggregation_warning: final_locked/shape_by_axis.csv averages the per-seed summaries; the model-card slope median (1.024) and span recovery (0.423) are the seed-pooled medians. Pick one convention and state it.
metrics.kshot: lanthanide_separation.gen8.evaluate.evaluate_fewshot, repeats=12, k in (0,1,2,3,5), policies (CENTRAL_THEN_SPREAD, MEDOID, D_OPTIMAL, RANDOM); frontier = mean over ligands of the mean MAE over (seed, fold, repeat), restricted to the 99-ligand common cohort
